    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActionPanel
    Bottom strip that tells the player what to do right now.
    ActionPicksBar
    Strip shown above the board while GuiPhase.ACTION_MINE is active.
    Artist
    An Artist character card.
    AutoPlayer
    Automated single-connection client that plays a full game without human input.
    Board
    Aggregate root for the shared game-area state: the two visible rows, the Offer Track, the Turn Order Tile, the tribe deck and the per-era building decks.
    BoardPanel
    The visual board.
    BoardRenderer
    Renders a SnapshotMessage as ASCII art to stdout.
    Builder
    A Builder character card.
    BuildingBadge
    The "buildings" token.
    BuildingCard
    A building card that a player can purchase and add to their tribe.
    BuildingEffect
    Strategy base class for all building card effects.
    CallBack
    Functional interface that receives a PropertyChangeEvent from the Model.
    Card
    Base class for all cards in the game.
    CardArtManifest
    Maps a model card name (e.g.
    CardComponent
    One card slot.
    CardComponent.Kind
     
    CardPick
    Identifies a single card slot that a player wishes to take: row (top/bottom) + slot index.
    CardZoomOverlay
    Full-window semi-transparent overlay that shows a single card enlarged.
    CavePaintingsEvent
    Cave paintings event: players with at least artistThreshold artists earn PP per artist; those below the threshold lose a fixed PP penalty.
    CharacterCard
    Abstract base class for all character cards that a player can recruit.
    CharacterType
    The six character types that a player can recruit into their tribe.
    ClientMessage
    Base class for all messages sent from client to server.
    ColorMessage
    Sent by the client during the lobby handshake to claim a totem color.
    CommandMessage
    Generic client-to-server message that wraps a raw command string.
    Controller
    Server-side Controller.
    ControllerWorker
    Single-threaded consumer that drains the shared ClientMessage queue.
    CountPanel
    Lobby step shown to the first player: pick how many players (2-5) with big buttons, on the warm MESOS gradient.
    DisconnectPanel
    Full-screen replacement shown when the GUI enters a non-playable state: another player disconnected and the game is terminated, the local connection was lost, or the server is unreachable.
    DisconnectPanel.Mode
     
    EndGamePanel
    Final-screen ranking panel shown after GAME_OVER.
    EndGameScoringEffect
    Building effect that awards extra prestige at game end based on the player's tribe composition (character counts, complete sets, or builders).
    EndGameScoringType
    Scoring strategy used by end-game building cards to award prestige points.
    Era
    The three eras of the game, each represented by a roman numeral.
    ErrMessage
    Error message sent from server to client when a command fails or an illegal action is detected.
    EventCard
    Abstract base class for event cards drawn from the tribe deck.
    EventType
    The four event types that can appear on tribe-deck event cards.
    ExtraPickBanner
    Banner shown only during GuiPhase.ACTION_EXTRA_PICK_MINE: yellow background, prominent "BONUS" title, and a SKIP button next to the description.
    ExtraTopRowPickEffect
     
    FinalEventCard
    Marker card placed at the bottom of the Tribe deck.
    Game
    Top-level orchestrator: owns the Board, the players, the round counter and the GamePhase state machine.
    GamePersistence
    Handles crash-recovery persistence for the game state.
    GamePhase
    The sequential phases that make up the game lifecycle.
    GameSnapshot
    Client-side mirror of the server state.
    GameSnapshot.CardInfo
    One slot in a visible row.
    GameSnapshot.Phase
     
    GameSnapshot.PlayerState
     
    GameSnapshot.TribeCard
    One acquired card in a player's tribe.
    Gatherer
    A Gatherer character card.
    GuiClient
    Swing client for MESOS, wired onto branch test's Transport protocol.
    GuiPhase
    Local UI state describing what the player's client expects to do next.
    HeartbeatMessage
    Keep-alive message sent by the server every few seconds.
    Hunter
    A Hunter character card.
    HuntingEvent
    Hunting event: each player gains 1 food per hunter plus any building bonuses, and earns prestige per hunter according to the printed reward value.
    InfoMessage
    Sent by the server to a client immediately after the lobby handshake.
    InventionIcon
    The ten distinct invention icons that appear on Inventor character cards.
    Inventor
    An Inventor character card.
    Launcher
    Unified entry point for the MESOS client.
    LobbyPanel
    Lobby screen — pick one of the 5 totem colours, send ColorMessage, then wait for the others to pick theirs.
    LoginMessage
    First message sent by any client after connecting.
    ModelListener
    Bridges PropertyChangeListener (required by the Model API) to the CallBack functional interface used by the server infrastructure.
    NoBuildingEffect
    Null-object implementation of BuildingEffect: no effect at all.
    OfferChoice
    The card picks a player has selected for a given OfferTile.
    OfferTile
    One Offer Tile on the offer track.
    OfferTileComponent
    One offer tile, painted with the original MESOS landscape art (sliced from fustelle_front_p1).
    OfferTileComponent.ClickHandler
     
    OfferTileId
    Identifier for each offer tile on the offer track (A through G).
    OfferTrack
    The offer track: the ordered collection of OfferTiles that players place their totem on.
    OfferTrackPanel
    The Offer Track — up to 7 painted tiles, A..G left to right.
    OfferTrackPanel.PlaceHandler
     
    OkMessage
    Positive acknowledgement sent from server to client.
    PerCharacterEventBonusEffect
    Building effect that grants extra food or prestige per qualifying character whenever a specific event type is resolved.
    PhaseController
    Local-only state machine that derives a GuiPhase from the latest server snapshot.
    PicksRemaining
    Per-tile pick budget remaining during ACTION_MINE.
    Player
    Represents one player: holds food, prestige points, their totem, their tribe, and the offer tile they have selected this round.
    PlayerColors
    Canonical mapping from server-side player id ("P1".."
    PlayerCount
    Supported player counts for a game session (2 to 5).
    PlayerPanel
    Compact sidebar player panel: totem badge + nickname + food/PP + chosen tile, plus an always-visible tribe counts bar (the "iconcine") and an expandable view of the player's actual cards.
    RankingMessage
    Sent by the server to all clients at the end of a game.
    RemoteGameCallback
    RMI callback interface implemented by the client.
    RemoteGameService
    RMI remote interface implemented by RemoteGameServiceImpl.
    RemoteGameServiceImpl
    RMI remote object: the server-side access point for RMI clients.
    ResourceCounter
    Resource counter: draws a token image (food or PP) with the numeric value centered below it.
    Resources
    Classpath PNG loader with a process-wide cache.
    RmiTransport
    RMI implementation of Transport.
    RmiVirtualView
    RMI implementation of VirtualView.
    RowPanel
    Horizontal strip of card slots above or below the offer track.
    RowRefillResult
    Value object returned by Board.refillTopRow(PlayerCount, Era) that describes what happened during the row refill: whether an era transition was triggered, which era was entered, and whether the tribe deck is now exhausted.
    RowSlot
    A single slot in a visible row.
    ScoreRepository
    Handles all MySQL database operations: creating the database if it does not exist, creating the game_results table if it does not exist, saving end-of-game results, and reading the global leaderboard.
    ScoreResult
    Aggregated leaderboard entry: one record per player across all games with the same number of players.
    ServerMain
     
    ServerMessage
    Marker interface for all messages sent from server to client.
    ServerRegistry
    Central server-side registry.
    Shaman
    A Shaman character card.
    ShamanicRitualEffect
    Building effect that modifies the player's shamanic ritual outcome: may add extra shaman icons, ignore the minority penalty, or double the majority reward.
    ShamanicRitualEvent
    Shamanic ritual event: the player(s) with the most shaman icons earn a PP reward; the player(s) with the fewest shaman icons lose a PP penalty.
    SnapshotMessage
    Full model snapshot sent from server to client after every state change.
    SnapshotMessage.PlayerSnapshot
    Per-player state snapshot.
    SnapshotMessage.SlotSnapshot
    One card slot in a visible row.
    SnapshotMessage.TileSnapshot
    One tile on the offer track.
    SnapshotMessage.TribeCardRef
    One acquired card in a player's tribe.
    StartMessage
    Command sent by a client to start the game.
    StatusBar
    Top strip showing the current GUI phase, round/era/player list, and whose turn it is.
    SustenanceDiscountEffect
    Building effect that reduces the sustenance cost by a fixed amount per character of the specified type in the player's tribe.
    SustenanceEvent
    Sustenance event: each player must pay food equal to their character count minus discounts.
    TcpClientHandler
    Per-client TCP handler.
    TcpTransport
    TCP implementation of Transport.
    TcpVirtualView
    TCP implementation of VirtualView.
    Theme
    Visual palette for the client UI.
    Totem
    A player's totem, identified by its colour.
    TotemBadge
    Renders one of the 5 MESOS totem PNGs (red / yellow / cyan / purple / white) at a fixed pixel size.
    TotemBadge.Colour
     
    TotemColor
    The five totem colours, one per player.
    Transport
    Abstracts the network transport layer from the view (TUI / GUI).
    Tribe
    One player's collection of acquired characters and buildings.
    TribeCardsPanel
    REMOVABLE expand module: renders a player's acquired tribe cards as small thumbnails (characters then buildings) via CardComponent.
    TribeCounts
    Pure aggregation of a player's tribe into per-type character counts and a building count.
    TribeCountsBar
    CORE always-visible tribe summary (the "iconcine"): a compact grid of the six character-type tokens plus a building token, each with its count.
    TribeDeckCard
    Abstract base class for cards that belong to the tribe deck (character cards and event cards).
    TriggeredFoodRewardEffect
    Building effect that grants food whenever the player's tribe reaches a new complete set or a new matching inventor pair (depending on the trigger type).
    TriggeredFoodRewardType
    Trigger condition used by TriggeredFoodRewardEffect to award food.
    TuiClient
    Text-based client for MESOS.
    TurnOrderPlacementEffect
    Building effect that grants extra food when the player places their totem on a turn-order space that has a food bonus (and is not the penalty space).
    TurnOrderSpace
    A single space on the TurnOrderTile.
    TurnOrderTile
    The turn-order tile: an ordered sequence of TurnOrderSpaces on which players place their totems during the action phase to claim their place in next round's turn order.
    TurnOrderTilePanel
    The Turn Order tile — the "Cave" illustration sliced from fustelle_front_p1.
    TurnOrderTilePanel.Space
     
    TypeTokenBadge
    A BoardGameArena-style type token: the character-type badge cropped from the card art (Resources.typeIcon(CharacterType)), scaled to fit, with a small count badge in the bottom-right corner.
    VirtualView
    Outbound channel from the server to one specific client.
    VisibleRow
    Identifies the top or bottom visible row on the board.
    VisibleRowState
    Holds the ordered list of RowSlots that make up a visible row (top or bottom).
